sentence_stem: If I had studied harder at school,
correct_completion: I would be a doctor by now.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder at school, I would be a doctor by now.
acceptable_variants: I would be working in a hospital today.
I would have a much better job now.

options.why_wrong: This states a present fact without a conditional structure, so it cannot complete a sentence that begins with a hypothetical past condition.

options.text: I would have been a doctor by now.
options.why_wrong: 'Would have been' refers to a completed past result, but 'by now' needs a present result, so the second half must use 'would be'.

options.text: I will be a doctor by now.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' is not used in the result clause of a conditional sentence about an imagined situation; 'would' is required.

options.text: I would be a doctor by now.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: past condition (had + past participle) with present result (would + base verb)
explanation: A mixed conditional links an unreal past condition with an unreal present result. The 'if'-clause uses the past perfect, while the main clause uses 'would' with a base verb to show the present effect. Russian speakers often mirror the Russian conditional 'бы' in both clauses, so they may wrongly use 'would have been' in the result.
translation: Если бы я учился усерднее в школе, сейчас я был бы врачом.
